sources.entry: Elai.io - AI video builder with custom avatars.

summary.name: Elai
summary.one_liner: Elai is a web-based AI video generator aimed at learning and development teams, turning text scripts, blog posts, or PPTX files into narrated videos with AI avatars.
use_cases: turn blog posts into narrated videos
produce localized videos in many languages
make elearning course videos without filming
summary.what_it_does: Elai generates videos from text: you type a script and an AI avatar narrates it, with text-to-speech in 75+ languages and 450+ accents. The page lists 80+ AI avatars and the option to create your own avatar of a company representative. Voice cloning is offered in 28 languages. Other features include an AI storyboard that builds a script and course outline, an article-to-video converter that takes a blog link, and a PPTX-to-video converter that produces editable slides. It also lists interactive video, a template library, a screen recorder, and one-click video translation.
notable: Turns blog links and PPTX files directly into narrated videos
80+ AI avatars plus custom avatar and voice cloning in 28 languages
Listed as powered by Panopto on the page title/meta description
caveats: Page says 'Start creating for free', but paid tiers and their limits are not described on the page
Feature list is marketing-heavy; output quality and limits are not independently specified
